title: Checks for print statements.
summary: print statements used for debugging should be omitted from production code. They can lead the accidental inclusion of sensitive information in logs, and are not configurable by clients, unlike logging statements. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-print and made it stable in v0.0.57.

title: Checks for pprint statements.
summary: Like print statements, pprint statements used for debugging should be omitted from production code. They can lead the accidental inclusion of sensitive information in logs, and are not configurable by clients, unlike logging statements. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-print and made it stable in v0.0.57.
